name: usage-report
description: Injects measured token usage on every user prompt via a UserPromptSubmit hook, so the model appends one line with last-turn and cumulative input/output tokens plus pure-compute and wall-clock duration at the end of its reply.

description_i18n.en: Injects measured token usage on every user prompt via a UserPromptSubmit hook, so the model appends one line with last-turn and cumulative input/output tokens plus pure-compute and wall-clock duration at the end of its reply.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过 UserPromptSubmit 钩子在每条用户消息时注入真实测量的用量数据，模型在自己回复末尾附上一行：上轮/累计的输入输出 tokens 与纯算耗时/墙钟跨度。
